text: この　せかいの　すべての　ポケモンを　きろくした　かんぺきな　ずかんを　つくること！

structure.jp: この　せかいの　すべての　ポケモンを　きろくした
structure.en: that recorded every Pokémon in this world

structure.jp: かんぺきな　ずかんを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きろくした　かんぺきな　ずかん
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb sits right before a thing and tells you which one. きろくした　かんぺきな　ずかん = 'a perfect encyclopedia that recorded (them)'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. つくること = 'making it', 'to make it'.
